status.bwr.reactor_controller.studs_all_: all %s studs are already at load
status.bwr.reactor_controller.head_alrea: the head is already off the vessel
status.bwr.reactor_controller.studs_tens: %s of the %s closure studs are still tensioned: detension them with a stud tensioner first
status.bwr.reactor_controller.head_alrea: the head is already on the vessel
status.bwr.reactor_controller.head_off_l: Head off, laid down clear of the vessel. The studs are bare. The crane can set it back on the flange.
status.bwr.reactor_controller.head_off_a: Head off, at %s. The studs are bare. The crane can set it back on the flange.
status.bwr.reactor_controller.head_on_ti: Head on, all %s closure studs at load. To open the vessel: depressurise, detension the studs with a stud tensioner, then lift the head with the crane.
status.bwr.reactor_controller.head_on_lo: Head on, all %s studs detensioned (nuts off). The vessel cannot hold pressure. The crane can lift the head.
status.bwr.reactor_controller.head_on_pa: Head on, %s of %s studs at load. The vessel cannot hold pressure until all are.
status.bwr.building_crane.head_out_queue: Queued: the crane lifts the head onto a head stand.
status.bwr.building_crane.head_in_queued: Queued: the crane sets the head back on the vessel.
status.bwr.reactor_panel_menu.head_proce: The head is not set on with a button. Lift it from its head stand with the reactor building crane, then bring the closure studs to load with a Stud Tensioner. (The server option instantHeadRemoval brings this button back.)

The head does not come off with a button. Depressurise to 25 psig or less, detension the closure studs with a Stud Tensioner beside the reactor, then lift the head onto a Head Stand with the reactor building crane. (The server option instantHeadRemoval brings this button back.)
tooltip.bwr.bottom_drain_port: Vessel penetration for the bottom head drain: the lowest two rows of a side wall, flange facing out. The RWCU pump's second suction.
tooltip.bwr.spent_resin: Radioactive waste from a stainless steel nanofilter. Handle it as such.
tooltip.bwr.capsule.contents: %s g of %s, sealed. Fuel for an RTG.
tooltip.bwr.capsule.power: %s W thermal, %s W electric in an RTG; half-life %s years
tooltip.bwr.capsule.dose: Carried: %s at 1 m. Keep it in an RTG.
tooltip.bwr.rwcu_pump.line1: Suction: back. Discharge: front. Draws reactor water from a recirculation outlet or the bottom drain port.
tooltip.bwr.rwcu_pump.line2: Electric: 60 kg/s at 130 psid, 120 kW. Starts only when you tell it to.
tooltip.bwr.rwcu_regen.line1: Hot side: reactor water in front, out back. Cold side: cleaned water in on the left, out on the right.
tooltip.bwr.rwcu_regen.line2: Returns about 92 percent of the heat to the water going back to feedwater. Optional.
tooltip.bwr.rwcu_cooler.line1: Process water: in front, out back. Cooling water: blue in on the left, cyan out on the right.
tooltip.bwr.rwcu_cooler.line2: Up to 8 MW. Optional: without it, or without cooling water, the nanofilter works on hot reactor water.
tooltip.bwr.rwcu_demin.line1: Inlet in front, outlet at the back. Holds 100 g of dissolved ions and 200 g of crud.
tooltip.bwr.rwcu_demin.line2: Works at reactor temperature. Change the element with a Stainless Steel Nanofilter Element.
tooltip.bwr.main_oil_tank.1: Set against any section of the shaft train. Holds 20,000 L of turbine oil (right-click with Turbine Oil Drums).
tooltip.bwr.main_oil_tank.2: AC auxiliary pump on the side and bottom faces, emergency DC pump on the top face (wire a battery). Cooling water on the two flanges.
tooltip.bwr.shaft_oil_pump: Bolts on the free shaft end of the generator, coupling toward it. Pumps oil in proportion to shaft speed.
tooltip.bwr.generator_cooling_skid.1: Set against the generator. Stator water pumps (FE on any face but the flanges), a hydrogen charge (Hydrogen Cylinders) and coolers on cooling water.
tooltip.bwr.generator_cooling_skid.2: Without cooling the winding heats with load; nothing trips. Cut the load.
status.bwr.turbine_aux.tank_full: The tank has no room for a whole drum.
status.bwr.turbine_aux.h2_full: The casing has no room for a whole cylinder.
status.bwr.new_fuel_elevator.not_on_pool: Not on a pool: stand the elevator on top of the rim of a formed spent fuel pool wall, on a straight run, not a corner.
status.bwr.new_fuel_elevator.pool_full: Every rack cell is taken (or promised to an assembly already waiting).
status.bwr.new_fuel_elevator.not_an_asse: Only fuel assemblies go in the hatch.
status.bwr.new_fuel_elevator.hatch_full: The hatch is full: %s assemblies are waiting.
status.bwr.new_fuel_elevator.busy: The carriage is busy: wait for it to finish.
status.bwr.new_fuel_elevator.nothing_to_: There is no assembly in the pool to raise.
status.bwr.new_fuel_elevator.landing_occ: An assembly is waiting at the hatch: take it out first.
status.bwr.new_fuel_elevator.state: New fuel elevator: %s; %s waiting; %s of %s rack cells free; %s m of water over an assembly at the transfer height (%s m needed).
status.bwr.new_fuel_elevator.trip: On its way: %s, %s s to go.
status.bwr.new_fuel_elevator.landing: An assembly waits at the hatch (%s kW decay heat). Take it out.
message.bwr.immersion.burning_warmth: You feel a burning warmth on your skin. The water here is not safe: get out. Dose rate %s, your dose so far %s.
status.bwr.large_rtg.refused: The Large RTG is full or will not take that: 1,000 kg is its limit
status.bwr.large_rtg.empty: Nothing in the Large RTG: it makes nothing
status.bwr.large_rtg.mass: %s kg of %s kg: %s W thermal, %s W electric, %s FE/t
status.bwr.large_rtg.heat_only: Heat only: no FE is made
status.bwr.rtg.heat_only: Heat only: no FE is made
status.bwr.large_rtg_item.size: 2 wide x 3 high x 2 deep. Leave it all clear; the clicked block is the corner.
status.bwr.large_rtg_item.capacity: Holds up to 1,000 kg of isotope ingots and blocks, mixed. Load by hand, hopper or pipe.
status.bwr.large_rtg_item.heavy: 40 cm of lead-equivalent housing. Read the dose on its screen.
